verdict.rationale: iTerm2's own docs show only narrow multi-item actions: AppleScript scripts that open multiple sessions with profiles into new tabs or windows, and Global Search across all tabs at once. No evidence shows a general bulk-operation feature, such as acting on or sending input to many sessions simultaneously; the Python API is only a building block. Missing for 10: a documented bulk action or broadcast across many sessions/panes, bulk operations beyond session launch and search, and hands-on corroboration.
